title: New law: Office of Compliance Administrative and Technical Corrections Act of 2015 (Public Law 114-6)
summary: H.R. 1213 of the 114th Congress became Public Law 114-6 on 2015-03-20.

title: New law: To award a Congressional Gold Medal to the Foot Soldiers who participated in Bloody Sunday, Turnaround Tuesday, or the final Selma to Montgomery Voting Rights March in March of 1965, which served as a catalyst for the Voting Rights Act of 1965. (Public Law 114-5)
summary: H.R. 431 of the 114th Congress became Public Law 114-5 on 2015-03-07.

title: New law: Department of Homeland Security Appropriations Act, 2015 (Public Law 114-4)
summary: H.R. 240 of the 114th Congress became Public Law 114-4 on 2015-03-04.

title: New law: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to ensure that emergency services volunteers are not taken into account as employees under the shared responsibility requirements contained in the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act. (Public Law 114-3)
summary: H.R. 33 of the 114th Congress became Public Law 114-3 on 2015-03-30.
